runtime_limitation: TT logits are read back through generator.generate(next_input=..., host_sampling=True, buffered=False). The generator's existing prefill path executes its sampler once per branch call, but that sampled token is discarded; subsequent host_sampling model replays skip sampling and the callback forces the branch. This captures forced-history logits and host-side distribution summaries, not the canonical device sampler candidate mapping, probability quantization, PRNG state, or sampled draw.
